::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/report_dashboards"}
#docs
ORG-LEVEL with an optional `business` rather than nested under it, because a dashboard may span the organization and then has no business to scope it to. Not paginated. Each row carries `is_mine`, resolved from the session — only the owner may change a dashboard.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `business` | `string` | no | Business public id. Omit to list the org-level dashboards, which are stored with no business. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The dashboards. |
| `total` | `integer` | Total number of dashboards. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/report_dashboards" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [],
  "total": 2900
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such business"
  }
}
```
